name: 19355 · Malvern, PA
findings: ZIP 19355 (Malvern) has 213 nonprofit organizations. 111 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 94 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19355 (Malvern) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
